heroLead:
Your repositories, tools, and coding agents.
Finally speaking the same language.
heroDetail: fx turns a shared manifest into a working environment.<br class="desktop-break" /> Know what’s here. Know what’s ready. Get to work.
baseline: BUILT FOR THE WAY ENGINEERS WORK
principlesLead:
Stop rebuilding the same mental map.
Give your team—and your agents—a shared one.
declareBody: Repositories, tools, owners, environments. Shared facts in a versioned manifest. Personal choices stay on your machine.
flowBody: Clone what’s missing. Update what’s clean. Dirty branches and unfinished work remain exactly where you left them.
agentBody: Structured answers, shared Skills, and explicit handoffs. Your agent can discover what to do—and what needs you.
architectureTitle:
One source of truth.
Zero black boxes.
architectureBody: fx orchestrates your workspace. Your tools keep their jobs: authentication, service APIs, and access control.
mapLabel: A team manifest flows through fx into repositories, tools and coding agents
closingBody:

Or build your first one in a few steps.
